content.title: About
content.content: Grape juice drink, light is a non‑alcoholic beverage made from 100 % grape juice diluted with water and lightly sweetened. It offers a bright fruity flavor, low calorie count, and a gentle carbonation, making it popular among both children and adults looking for a refreshing and healthier option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grape juice contains polyphenols such as resveratrol, known for antioxidant properties.
The light version typically contains about 5 g of sugar per 100 ml, roughly half of regular fruit juices.
Grape varieties used are often sourced from temperate regions where berries have high sugar and aromatic compound levels.
The drink can be still or lightly carbonated, influencing taste perception.
Many light grape juice drinks are fortified with vitamin C to boost immune support.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Polyphenols and flavonoids in grape juice help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Resveratrol may improve endothelial function and lower LDL cholesterol.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High water content aids in maintaining proper fluid balance.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Fortified vitamin C enhances immune function and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The light formulation provides fewer calories, useful for weight management.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Even reduced, the drink still contains sugar that can affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Grape allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to grape components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic pH may irritate sensitive tooth enamel; rinsing the mouth after consumption is advisable.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some versions may include preservatives (e.g., potassium sorbate) which can be problematic for sensitive people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the drink chilled on its own, add it to smoothies, cocktails, or use as a base for fruit punches.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
